DiscoDJ past-lightcones — from smooth fields to catalogues

Every panel below comes from a single differentiable 2-LPT past-lightcone (256³ particles, 4000 Mpc/h box, Planck18), generated and rendered by docs/make_lightcone_gallery.py. Mass is deposited with phase-space-sheet over-sampling (2³ sub-particles per cell) for a smooth, alias-free field. The same pipeline scales to 1024³ and refreshes across cosmologies for Fisher / inference work.
